A short video my friend and I made about NYC shot entirely on Google Glass. Let us know what you think!
The video looks like a go pro, but I'm very interested in hearing what you have to say about the google glass. How convenient is it? What all can it do? And any other opinions you have on the matter.

It was pretty tricky getting the hang of the glass actually. I think the concept and overall idea of it is really cool but it needs some work. One of the biggest problems we had was the battery life. It would film for about 20 minutes and then need to charge for at least half an hour. Because of that I'd actually have to say it is not very convenient. At times it felt a bit more like a burden than an actual tool. That being said every once in a while we would get such an awesome shot that it almost made it worth it. Also the sound is terrible, but I wasn't too surprised by that. We did not get to play around too much with the other features that it had besides filming and photography. My overall opinion is that it can do a lot as far as first person filmmaking goes and I am very excited to see what future models improve on but as it is right now I found it to be a tad difficult to work with and not totally worth the hassle. Like I said though the potential is there.

Hope that answered your question, sorry if it was vague its been a while since I had my hands on it so the memory isn't too fresh. If there are any other questions you might have though I'd be happy to give my opinion on the matter or even track down some fellow filmmakers who also worked with the glass and help you get a few different points of views, just let me know!
